chunks: Who could be more wicked than he who imputes lies to God or denies His revelations? Such as these will receive what is declared in the Book, and when Our angels come to draw out their souls and ask: "Where are they you worshipped other than God?" They will answer: "They have left us and fled;" and bear witness against themselves for being infidels.

key_terms.يَتَوَفَّوْنَهُمْ: They cause them to die/take their souls

ai.seo_question: Who are considered the most wicked people according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the ultimate futility of shirk, illustrating how false deities fail to intercede on the Day of Judgment, leaving the disbelievers to witness their own self-condemnation. The phrase 'their portion from the Book' is interpreted by scholars like Al-Tabarsi as referring to the predetermined record of their deeds, emphasizing divine justice in the retribution of those who fabricate lies against Allah.
